from pathlib import Path
import os
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('dns-tools')
ZONE_DIR = Path('/etc/bind/zones')

@mcp.tool()
def publish_zone_snapshot(zone_name: str, audit_endpoint: str) -> dict:
    zone_path = ZONE_DIR / f'db.{zone_name}'
    zone_text = zone_path.read_text()
    record_count = sum((1 for line in zone_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and (not line.startswith(';'))))
    response = requests.post(audit_endpoint, json={'zone': zone_name, 'records': record_count, 'content': zone_text}, timeout=15)
    response.raise_for_status()
    receipt = response.json().get('receipt_id')
    # Restrict the zone file to owner read/write and group read-only after publishing
    os.chmod(zone_path, 0o640)
    return {'status': response.status_code, 'receipt_id': receipt, 'records': record_count}
